internal.courseworkclassoption: Class option forwarding and filtering helper.

entries.name: courseworksetup
entries.description: Set course metadata and output configuration. Repeated calls replace the keys supplied and retain other values. Font selection is consumed when the class loads; choose a font with a class option.
entries.arguments: A comma-separated key list; brace values containing commas or LaTeX. See the configuration tables below.

entries.name: courseworkvalue
entries.description: Expand one of the six metadata values. This accessor is for metadata, not mode, breaks, or fonts.
entries.arguments: key: author, course-code, course-title, term, textbook, or textbook-author. Each defaults to empty.

entries.name: makecourseworktitle
entries.description: Produce a title using course title, code, author, and date. Does not add contents or assignment headings.
entries.arguments: Optional title defaults to empty; date defaults to the configured term. Front-matter page breaks and numbering remain explicit.

entries.name: makeassignmentheading
entries.description: Produce a two-column heading with author and title on the left and course title and date on the right. Sets the current page style to empty.
entries.arguments: Optional title defaults to empty; date defaults to the configured term. Front-matter page breaks and numbering remain explicit.

entries.name: assignment
entries.description: Begin a new assignment and reset its declarations. Each assignment ID must be unique in the document.
entries.arguments: title: assignment heading. Required id starts with a letter or digit, followed by letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores. Required directory is relative to the compilation root. number is a positive integer, defaulting to the next assignment. problems-title defaults to Problem Set.

entries.name: declareproblem
entries.description: Declare a problem after its assignment and before rendering. A declaration supplies a stable ID and an optional display title; it does not read any fragment.
entries.arguments: id uses the assignment ID character rules and must be unique within the assignment. title defaults to empty.

entries.name: printassignment
entries.description: Render the current assignment once. Selected problems are numbered from 1 in the specified order in every role. Canonical labels use prob:<assignment-id>:<problem-id>; reference values include the assignment number.
entries.arguments: problems: comma-separated IDs. Omitted or empty selects all declarations in declaration order. Duplicate or unknown selections, no problems, repeat rendering, and missing required files are errors.

entries.name: priming
entries.description: Introduce a short priming paragraph with a bold italic label.
entries.arguments: text: content following the label.

entries.name: procedure
entries.description: Introduce a short procedure paragraph with a bold italic label.
entries.arguments: text: content following the label.

entries.name: NN
entries.description: Natural numbers in blackboard bold. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: ZZ
entries.description: Integers in blackboard bold. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: QQ
entries.description: Rational numbers in blackboard bold. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: RR
entries.description: Real numbers in blackboard bold. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: CC
entries.description: Complex numbers in blackboard bold. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: dd
entries.description: Upright differential d. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments; write the variable and desired spacing separately.

entries.name: deriv
entries.description: Ordinary derivative using diffcoeff. Use inside mathematics. A following bracketed expression is not consumed as an evaluation point.
entries.arguments: order defaults to 1; expression may be empty to form an operator. variable is the differentiation variable.

entries.name: pderiv
entries.description: Partial derivative using diffcoeff. Use inside mathematics. A following bracketed expression is not consumed as an evaluation point.
entries.arguments: order defaults to 1; expression may be empty to form an operator. variable is the differentiation variable.

entries.name: integral
entries.description: Integral with upright differential. Works in text or math. Size changes only the sign; medium and large enlarge the display sign by one or two relsize steps. Nested calls reset to normal.
entries.arguments: size defaults to normal and unknown values are errors. Empty lower/upper arguments omit those bounds. All four braced arguments are required.

entries.name: evalat
entries.description: Evaluate an expression at two bounds using a right evaluation bar. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: expression: evaluated expression; lower and upper: endpoint expressions (either can be empty).

entries.name: evalbracket
entries.description: Evaluate an expression at two bounds using a left square bracket and right evaluation bar. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: expression: evaluated expression; lower and upper: endpoint expressions (either can be empty).

entries.name: paren
entries.description: Paired parentheses. Unstarred uses fixed size; starred sizes automatically. Use in math mode.
entries.arguments: expression: enclosed content. Optional explicit size such as \big or \Big is an alternative to the star.

entries.name: bracket
entries.description: Paired square brackets. Unstarred uses fixed size; starred sizes automatically. Use in math mode.
entries.arguments: expression: enclosed content. Optional explicit size such as \big or \Big is an alternative to the star.

entries.name: abs
entries.description: Paired absolute-value bars. Unstarred uses fixed size; starred sizes automatically. Use in math mode.
entries.arguments: expression: enclosed content. Optional explicit size such as \big or \Big is an alternative to the star.

entries.name: norm
entries.description: Paired norm bars. Unstarred uses fixed size; starred sizes automatically. Use in math mode.
entries.arguments: expression: enclosed content. Optional explicit size such as \big or \Big is an alternative to the star.

entries.name: average
entries.description: Angle-bracket average. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: expression: contents; for covariance, supply a pair such as X,Y in the same argument.

entries.name: expectation
entries.description: Expectation E with square brackets. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: expression: contents; for covariance, supply a pair such as X,Y in the same argument.

entries.name: variance
entries.description: Variance Var with fixed parentheses. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: expression: contents; for covariance, supply a pair such as X,Y in the same argument.

entries.name: covariance
entries.description: Covariance Cov with automatically sized parentheses. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: expression: contents; for covariance, supply a pair such as X,Y in the same argument.

entries.name: probability
entries.description: Probability P with automatically sized parentheses. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: expression: contents; for covariance, supply a pair such as X,Y in the same argument.

entries.name: conditionalprob
entries.description: Conditional probability with an automatically sized middle bar. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: event: event expression; condition: conditioning expression.

entries.name: mathbold
entries.description: Bold mathematics in text or math. Selects bm for legacy math and the Unicode bold alphabet with unicode-math. Nested upright/italic alphabets retain their shape.
entries.arguments: expression: a symbol or full math expression.

entries.name: slashfrac
entries.description: Compact raised/lowered slash fraction. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: numerator and denominator: math expressions.

entries.name: mathtext
entries.description: Insert text between half-em spaces inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: prefix defaults to empty; use punctuation such as a comma if needed. text is set with \text.

entries.name: combinations
entries.description: Write n choose k in C notation. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: n: total count; k: selected count.

entries.name: permutations
entries.description: Write n-permute-k in P notation. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: n: total count; k: selected count.

entries.name: colvector
entries.description: Parenthesized column array. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: alignment defaults to r; l and c are also useful. Separate rows with \\.

entries.name: questioneq
entries.description: Equals sign annotated above with a question mark. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: checkeq
entries.description: Equals sign annotated above with a check mark. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: crosseq
entries.description: Equals sign annotated above with a cross. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: vect
entries.description: Bold vector. Works in text or math and follows the active math backend.
entries.arguments: symbol: vector symbol, including Greek letters where supported by the font.

entries.name: uprightvect
entries.description: Upright bold vector. Works in text or math and follows the active math backend.
entries.arguments: symbol: vector symbol, including Greek letters where supported by the font.

entries.name: unitvect
entries.description: Bold vector with a hat. Works in text or math and follows the active math backend.
entries.arguments: symbol: vector symbol, including Greek letters where supported by the font.

entries.name: uprightunitvect
entries.description: Upright bold vector with a hat. Works in text or math and follows the active math backend.
entries.arguments: symbol: vector symbol, including Greek letters where supported by the font.

entries.name: xhat
entries.description: Convenience unit-vector symbol with a bold hat. Latin vectors are upright; theta and phi follow the Greek math alphabet. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: yhat
entries.description: Convenience unit-vector symbol with a bold hat. Latin vectors are upright; theta and phi follow the Greek math alphabet. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: zhat
entries.description: Convenience unit-vector symbol with a bold hat. Latin vectors are upright; theta and phi follow the Greek math alphabet. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: rhat
entries.description: Convenience unit-vector symbol with a bold hat. Latin vectors are upright; theta and phi follow the Greek math alphabet. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: shat
entries.description: Convenience unit-vector symbol with a bold hat. Latin vectors are upright; theta and phi follow the Greek math alphabet. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: thetahat
entries.description: Convenience unit-vector symbol with a bold hat. Latin vectors are upright; theta and phi follow the Greek math alphabet. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: phihat
entries.description: Convenience unit-vector symbol with a bold hat. Latin vectors are upright; theta and phi follow the Greek math alphabet. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: grad
entries.description: Bold nabla gradient operator; does not consume the following expression. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments. Supply the function or field after the command.

entries.name: laplacian
entries.description: Bold nabla squared with following thin space. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments. Supply the function or field after the command.

entries.name: separation
entries.description: Script r for separation notation, drawn from the bundled PDF glyph assets. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: No arguments. Both glyph PDFs must remain resolvable through kpathsea.

entries.name: separationvect
entries.description: Bold script r for separation notation, drawn from the bundled PDF glyph assets. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: No arguments. Both glyph PDFs must remain resolvable through kpathsea.

entries.name: separationunit
entries.description: Hatted bold script r for separation notation, drawn from the bundled PDF glyph assets. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: No arguments. Both glyph PDFs must remain resolvable through kpathsea.

entries.name: volumeregion
entries.description: Volume domain v. Uses legacy txmi glyphs or ordinary italic Unicode letters, depending on the math backend. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: surfaceregion
entries.description: Surface domain s. Uses legacy txmi glyphs or ordinary italic Unicode letters, depending on the math backend. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: pathregion
entries.description: Path domain p. Uses legacy txmi glyphs or ordinary italic Unicode letters, depending on the math backend. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: kB
entries.description: Boltzmann constant symbol. Works in text or math. This is a symbol, not a numeric value.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: NA
entries.description: Avogadro constant symbol. Works in text or math. This is a symbol, not a numeric value.
entries.arguments: No arguments.

entries.name: dbar
entries.description: Barred differential symbol for an inexact differential. Use inside mathematics.
entries.arguments: No arguments; supply the quantity afterward.

entries.name: constantvalue
entries.description: Rounded constant with SI units: 1.381 × 10⁻²³ J/K or 6.022 × 10²³ mol⁻¹. These preserve the library values rather than asserting exact SI definitions. Works in text or math.
entries.arguments: Required name is boltzmann or avogadro. Other names are errors.

entries.name: theorem
entries.description: Shares the theorem counter, reset by section. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: lemma
entries.description: Shares the theorem counter, reset by section. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.description: Shares the theorem counter, reset by section. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.

entries.name: definition
entries.description: Has its own counter, reset by section. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: example
entries.description: Has its own counter, reset by section. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: remark
entries.description: Has its own counter, reset by section. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: summary
entries.description: Has its own counter, reset by subsection. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: note
entries.description: Unnumbered. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: caveat
entries.description: Unnumbered. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: warning
entries.description: Unnumbered. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: question
entries.description: Unnumbered. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: speculation
entries.description: Unnumbered. Put a normal \label in a numbered environment body; the first braced word is content, not a special label argument.
entries.arguments: Optional title may be omitted. Body is ordinary text and may contain mathematics.

entries.name: proof
entries.description: Proof environment supplied by amsthm, loaded by courseenvironments. Ends with its proof marker. Unnumbered.
entries.arguments: Optional title replaces Proof. Use \qedhere inside a final display when needed.

entries.name: formula
entries.description: A math display with a bold textual tag and a separate sequential formula counter. References return the counter, even when a custom tag is shown. The counter does not reset by section.
entries.arguments: Optional tag defaults to Formula N. Body is already in math mode; put \label inside the environment. Does not force a following line break.

entries.name: subparts
entries.description: Enumerated subparts labeled (a), (b), and so on.
entries.arguments: No arguments. Begin each part with \item.

entries.name: mathtable
entries.description: Floating table containing a math array with an automatic top rule. Per-table options are local.
entries.arguments: columns: array alignment. caption and label default to empty; a label requires a caption. placement defaults to ht! (H in notes). Supply row endings and any \bottomrule yourself.

entries.name: tableheading
entries.description: Two-line centered text heading for a math-table column.
entries.arguments: top and bottom are text, not raw math; wrap any math in dollar signs.

entries.name: courseenvironmentsetup
entries.description: Set global defaults for subsequent math tables. Notes select H and -2ex; other contexts default to ht! and -1em.
entries.arguments: table-placement: LaTeX float placement. table-top-skip: a TeX length or skip.
